svg.title: Native owner components: durability-path resource profile

cc:Work.dc:title: Native owner components: durability-path resource profile
cc:Work.dc:description: Each instance is one NeuronRuntime + SparseJournal + independent FileAnchorWitnessStore. Main points use valid windows; 4096 uses the confirmation run. Measurements occurred in separate shared-host windows: four warmup and 32 measured rounds. Owner latency includes witness fsync; queue age is separate. p95/p99 are descriptive run quantiles; there are only 32 complete-batch samples. RSS includes initialization and timing arrays, captured before reopen. This view measures the native component path with a fixed projection. It does not qualify trained RR scale performance or production Cell deployment.
